name: San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 19, 2014 -
5:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Board Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 10/15/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-11-19 SDWD Item S8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-11-19 SDWD Item S8B - Warrants
8C.
San Dieguito Water District's Monthly Informational Report. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Accept San Dieguito Water District's Monthly Informational Report.
2014-11-19 SDWD Item S8C - Monthly Informational Report
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Terminate the contract with Wier Construction by mutual agreement and award a contract to Burtech Pipeline, Inc. for the Neptune/Downtown Valve Replacement Project. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Authorize the General Manager to terminate the contract with Wier Construction by mutual agreement and in the District's best interest for the Neptune/Downtown Valve Replacement Project and negotiate a settlement price for work completed. Award the remaining portion of the project to Burtech Pipeline, Inc. in the amount of $452,620, plus a $33,891 contingency.
2014-11-19 SDWD Item S10A - Terminate Contract with Wier Construction
10B.
Award construction contract for the Transmission Line Valve Replacement Project. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Award contract to Piperin Corporation for construction of the Transmission Line Valve Replacement Project in the amount of $342,500, plus 10% contingency. Transfer $119,306 from the Saxony Road Interconnect Project (CW10F) to the Transmission Line Valve Replacement Project (CW01A).
2014-11-19 SDWD Item S10B - Award Transmission Valve Replacement Project
10C.
In lieu agreement with CV Encinitas Lake St, LLC regarding a Condition of Development to install a Recycled Water Main for TM 10-028. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
Authorize the General Manager to enter into an In Lieu Agreement between the San Dieguito Water District and CV Encinitas Lake St, LLC Regarding a Condition of Development to Install a Recycled Water Main for TM 10-028.
2014-11-19 SDWD Item S10C - In Lieu Agreement with CV Encinitas Lake St, LLC
10D.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2013/14 Year-End Financial Results. Contact Person: Administrative Services Manager Umbrasas
Receive and file this report reflecting the San Dieguito Water District's actual FY 2013/14 available ending fund balance of $12,507,468.
2014-11-19 SDWD Item S10D - FY13-14 SDWD Year-End Financial Results
10E.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2014/15 1st Quarter Budget Report. Contact Person: Administrative Services Manager Umbrasas
1) Receive and file this report reflecting a revised actual beginning available fund balance of $12,507,468; 2) Approve requests for 1st quarter budget adjustments as noted in this report; and 3) Adopt Resolution 2014-07 entitled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District, Adopting Position Titles and Pay Ranges for Fiscal Year 2014/15."
2014-11-19 SDWD Item S10E - FY14-15 1st Quarter Budget Report
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Informational presentation on the Drought and Response to the District's Declaration of a Drought Response Level 2 Condition. Contact Person: Assistant General Manager O'Donnell
District Board receive the presentation, discuss the information presented and provide direction as appropriate.
2014-11-19 SDWD Item S11A - Presentation on Drought and Response to DRL2C
S12.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY BOARD MEMBERS
S13.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S14.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
S15.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
